channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Petco Park’s 22-block neighborhood now has its own cleaning crew
item.description: The 22-block area around Petco Park now has its own dedicated crews 15-hour day to make the neighborhood clean and safe.

item.title: Feds foil New Year’s Eve bombing plot targeting SoCal companies
item.description: Federal authorities said Monday that they foiled a plot to bomb multiple sites of two U.S. companies on New Year’s Eve in Southern California after arresting members of an extremist anti-capitalist and anti-government group.

item.title: Lupita Infante, Vince Guaraldi, the Film Company and 7 other great concerts this week
item.description: Lupita Infante highlights a week of concerts that includes three different flavors of live Christmas music to ring in the season.

item.title: Six cities in the county have banned e-bikes for children — and San Diego may soon join them
item.description: Coronado, Chula Vista, Poway, San Marcos, and now Santee have all passed ordinances barring anyone under the age of 12 from riding an e-bike. Carlsbad has joined this bunch, declaring its intention to draft an ordinance in the coming months.

item.title: EPA unveils tougher U.S.-Mexico pact to end Tijuana River sewage crisis
item.description: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency announced an agreement Monday between the United States and Mexico intended to permanently end the Tijuana River sewage crisis, the latest in a long line of agreements intended to accomplish the same.

item.title: San Diego law enforcement condemns Australia shooting, steps up security
item.description: San Diego County law enforcement officials Monday condemned the hate-related mass shooting in Australia and said that while there are no known similar, active threats in San Diego, officials were monitoring any and all potential local developments.

item.title: New line of defense: Oceanside opens fire station in North River Farms
item.description: The Oceanside Fire Department Monday cut the ribbon on Fire Station 9 in the North River Farms neighborhood at the base of the South Morro Hills community.

item.title: Is your street on the list? City begins resurfacing in multiple neighborhoods
item.description: City crews will begin work on slurry seal street repairs and resurfacing in Skyline Hills, Paradise Hills, Otay Mesa, Encanto and Eastern San Diego this week, officials announced Monday.

item.title: Save the date! LA28 Olympics ticket draw registration opens Jan. 14
item.description: Registration for the LA28 ticket draw for all Olympic sports will begin on Jan. 14, marking the first chance for fans to secure a time slot to purchase a pass for the international event.

item.title: Sunny skies for now, but Santa might bring rain to San Diego County this Christmas
item.description: High pressure will keep San Diego County dry and warmer than normal through Friday, with cooler temperatures arriving this weekend, according to the National Weather Service.
